title: [finding] the runtime dispatcher answers `GET /meta/:type/:name?layers=true` with the plain read's envelope, where `RestServer` answers the layered envelope with `Deprecation: true`
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` `handleMetadataRequest`, the item read's `?layers=true` flag. Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` was measured at a public door, `dispatch()` (the delegate of `createHonoApp`'s catch-all), by the #20408 dev with a scratch probe on PR #20473's head `cf85a44a`. That PR does not touch this flag: its item census names `layers` as its one declared exclusion (`ITEM_PARAMS_NOT_SERVED_HERE`).

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, session `local_1d2a197c-c20e-4e90-9be8-413d4d432289`) from the #20408 round. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

| request | dispatcher | `RestServer` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/app/crm?layers=true` | 200 `{ type, name, item }`, the plain read | 200 `{ type, name, code, overlay, effective }`, with `Deprecation: true` |
| `GET /meta/app/crm/layers` | a located 404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (loud) | the layered answer |

The route is refused loudly. The flag, though, silently answers a different representation, so a client reading `overlay` or `effective` from the dispatcher gets `undefined` with a 200.

## The contract

AGENTS.md 〈Route & surface ownership〉 rule 1: one implementation, two transports. Ruling B on #20156 (`5856774816`) item 2 fixed what `/layers` and `?layers=true` answer on `RestServer`. The dispatcher answers neither form of it.

## Duplicate check

Board search, open and closed, taken in the act that filed this card:
- 「dispatcher layers=true」: 16 hits. #20408 is open and excludes this flag by name. #20156, #20193 and #20378 are closed and about read gates, not this representation.
- 「layers query dispatcher plain read」: 25 hits, none on this divergence.

Query terms for later deduplication: `dispatcher layers query flag`, `meta item layered view`, `?layers=true plain envelope`, `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema dispatcher`.
